appName: Color Breathing VR - Relaxation and Mindfulness Meditation through Breathwork
displayName: Color Breathing VR - Relaxation and Mindfulness Meditation through Breathwork
display_name: Color Breathing VR - Relaxation and Mindfulness Meditation through Breathwork
display_long_description:
Slow down, breathe, and give yourself a few quiet minutes.

Color Breathing is a simple VR relaxation experience built around breathwork, meditation, mindfulness, and immersive visual guidance. A calm space to focus on your breathing and reset.

Use Color Breathing when you want to:

Unwind after a long day
De-stress and clear your head
Practice guided breathing
Meditate without distractions
Take a quiet break from games, work, or everyday stress
Build a relaxing wind-down routine

The experience is designed to be easy to start, even if you have never meditated before. Put on your headset, follow the visual breathing rhythm, and take a few minutes away from everything else.

Whether you think of it as meditation, breathwork, mindfulness, or simply a peaceful VR escape, Color Breathing gives you a simple way to slow down, breathe, and relax.
